title: Indian Bank Recruitment 2026 – Apprentice Posts
shortInfo: Indian Bank has announced notification for Apprentice posts. Required qualification: Graduate degree in any discipline. Last date to apply: 25-11-26.

dates.event: Opening Date for Online Registration & Payment of Application Fees
Closing Date for Online Registration & Payment of Application Fees

howToApply: Register on the NATS 2.0 Portal (www.nats.education.gov.in) before applying. Only candidates who passed graduation on or after 1st April 2022 need to register here. Ensure 100% complete profile on the portal.
Note down the Enrolment ID generated in NATS 2.0 Portal for future correspondence.
Visit the Bank’s website www.indianbank.bank.in and click on the Careers page or visit https://www.nats.education.gov.in and click on ‘Engagement of Apprentices in Indian Bank – 2026’.
Click on ‘Click here for New Registration’, enter Name, contact details and email ID. Note the Provisional Registration Number and Password generated.
Fill in the application form. Use ‘SAVE AND NEXT’ to save data if unable to complete in one go.

Upload scanned photograph (4.5cm x 3.5cm, 20KB–50KB), signature (black ink on white paper, 10KB–20KB), left thumb impression (20KB–50KB), and handwritten declaration (50KB–100KB) as per specifications in Annexure-II.
Preview and verify all details before clicking ‘COMPLETE REGISTRATION’.
Proceed to the ‘Payment’ tab and pay the application fee online using Debit/Credit Card or Internet Banking.
On successful payment, an e-Receipt will be generated. Take a printout of the e-Receipt and online application form for future reference.
Do NOT send the printout to the Bank.

title: Chandigarh District Court Recruitment 2026 – Gate Keeper, Chowkidar, Parking Attendant Posts
shortInfo: Chandigarh District Court has announced notification for Gate Keeper, Chowkidar, Parking Attendant posts. Required qualification: Middle Standard, Hindi/Punjabi knowledge. Last date to apply: 16-11-26.
howToApply: Obtain the prescribed application form from the official website: https://chandigarh.dcourts.gov.in/
Fill the application form legibly with complete particulars including contact number and E-mail ID.
A separate application form must be submitted for each individual post.
Attach self-attested copies of relevant testimonials (proof of educational qualifications, category, date of birth, photo-identity proof, etc.).
Attach two recent passport size coloured photographs duly self-attested (one pasted on the application form and one stapled).
Submit the signed application form along with all required supporting documents to: The District and Sessions Judge, Chandigarh, New District Court Complex, Sector 43, Chandigarh.
Applications must reach the office by 05:00 PM of 16.11.2026. Applications received after this deadline or in soft/electronic form will be rejected.

dates.event: Last Date to Submit Online Application

howToApply: Visit the official website of Punjab and Haryana High Court at www.highcourtchd.gov.in.
Read the detailed employment notice/advertisement before filling up the application form.

Keep personal details, valid email address, active mobile number, online payment facility, scanned passport size photograph (not more than 30 days old) against white background, scanned signatures, and other required documents ready.
Fill all details including category correctly in the online application form.
Upload proper photograph and signature; incomplete applications will be rejected.
Pay the application fee online (non-refundable). Online transaction charges will be levied extra.
Submit the application form only after ensuring all particulars/details are correctly reflected.
Retain printed copies of the online application form for future reference.
For technical queries, call Helpline: 8100091298 on working days between 11:00 AM to 05:30 PM. For other queries, call 0172-2717605 on working days between 09:30 AM to 05:00 PM.
